title: Black-Hole Signatures in the Finite-Temperature Critical Ising Chain
summary: We demonstrate that the finite-temperature critical transverse-field Ising chain exhibits quantitative signatures of black-hole physics in its dual gravitational description within the AdS/CFT correspondence. Its finite-temperature dynamics and thermodynamics are consistently captured by a mixed thermal-AdS/BTZ black hole saddle, leading to three mutually compatible observations.
